/-! ## Registry (WC4 C12) -/

/-- Synchronization entry (WC4 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
structure SyncEntry where
  guarded : Nat
  grant : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Synchronization registry (WC4 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry

/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC4 C12: "at its declared field
position", `guardedField`, `controlField`): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
ordered children of the mutex value. -/
structure MutexLayout where
  guardedField : Nat
  controlField : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC4 C12). -/
def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded

/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC4 C12). -/
instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance

/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) =>
    match parentOf s.P h with
    | some m =>
      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
    | none => none
  | _ => none

/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC4 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }

/-- WC4 C14.3: the frame `f` has effective and exercisable access to `ControlOf(e)` under the
condition of Spec 1 §68.2: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
present effective mode on the controller. -/
def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False

/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance

/-- The authorization facts of WC4 C14 for an entry: C14.1 (live), C14.2 (`grant = none`), C14.3
(`CtrlRight`). -/
def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance

/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the
library (WC4 C14, C25): an entry of the registry with the requested `guarded` identity satisfies
the authorization facts C14.1–C14.3. -/
def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance

/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library (WC4 C14, C25), the registry type being
`SyncReg` (WC4 C2). -/
def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : KC SyncReg :=
  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L }

/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable ((libKC k L).SyncAuthorized reg s g f) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))

/-- Contract obligation of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
synchronization contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the
`guarded` of a live entry of `reg`. -/
def SyncSound (kc : KC SyncReg) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s

/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC4 C14. -/
theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
    SyncSound (libKC k L) reg s :=
  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩

/-- The holder is a usable place (WC4 C12, C13.1, C21.1). -/
def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place q => t.Usable q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC4 C12). -/
instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance

/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC4 C13.5). -/
def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  match y.holder with
  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance

/-- The place `slot` holding `guarded` (WC4 C12). -/
def slotOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => some h
  | _ => none

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C21, C22) -/

/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
(WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C21.5, C22). -/
def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g

/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C22). -/
def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j

/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded

/-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
`ControlOf` leaves. -/
def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `slot`: for every live entry, every structural leaf of
the place holding `guarded` is `Init`. -/
def SlotInit (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.I l = .init) False

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `ctl`: for every live entry, the controller leaf
`ControlOf(entry)` is `Init`. -/
def CtlInit (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.I ctl = .init) False

/-- `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7): items 1–5 and 7 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
  place. -/
  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  /-- WC4 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
  leaf. -/
  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.4, second clause (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC4 C13.7): distinct
  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
  /-- WC4 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  /-- WC4 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
  §38: identities are indices). -/
  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the structural leaves of `slot` are `Init`. -/
  slotInit : SlotInit s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the controller leaf is `Init`. -/
  ctlInit : CtlInit L s reg

/-! ## Arena registry and the registries of live administrations (Spec 1 §46, §56) -/

/-- The arena registry (Spec 1 §46): library state separate from the kernel state and from the
synchronization registry (WC4 C2: library administration states remain separate from `S_C`). -/
abbrev ArenaReg := List Arena.ArenaEntry

/-- The synchronization registry as a registry of live administrations (Spec 1 §56; WC4 C13.7):
the `guarded` identities of its live entries. -/
def liveGuardeds (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : List Nat :=
  (reg.filter fun e => decide (e.Live s)).map (·.guarded)

/-! ## Derived operations (WC4 C13, C16–C18) -/

/-- The mutex value `M` of WC4 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
holding `guarded`. -/
def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => parentOf s.P h
  | _ => none

/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13.1–C13.10), the arena registry
`ar` being the other registry of live administrations (Spec 1 §56). The interface and realization
obligations of WC4 C13 (C13.3, C13.6, initial physical controller state) are not represented: WC4
C13 says they "are not claimed to follow from the authority-only state `S_C`". -/
structure NewMutexPre (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (ar : ArenaReg) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded` (Spec 1 §43). -/
  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
  /-- WC4 C13.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a
  usable leaf. -/
  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.4: `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅`. -/
  disjointM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False
  /-- WC4 C13.10: every structural leaf of `footprint(M)` is `Init`. -/
  initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False
  /-- WC4 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
  /-- WC4 C13.6: `K.SharedMutable(ctl)`. -/
  sharedMutable : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the `internal` identity of a live arena of the
  arena registry. -/
  otherAdmin : g ∉ Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar
  /-- WC4 C13.8: no other live entry is associated with `ctl`. -/
  ctlUnique : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.9. -/
  available : NoCoveringDesc s g

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC4 C13). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (ar : ArenaReg) (s : SC)
    (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) : Decidable (NewMutexPre k L ar s reg c g) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False ∧
    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
      ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s g)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩⟩

/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created (WC4 C13 effect). WC4 C13 states no outcome
other than success; only `ok` is defined. -/
def NewMutexOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (ar : ArenaReg) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPre k L ar s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])

/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C16): with the library instantiation of
`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` on the registry `reg` and the record of the
fresh grant identity `|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not
enabled; WC4 C16 states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c e.guarded ∧
    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })

/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C17.1–C17.4): O3 releases the grant and the registry
records `grant = none` (WC4 C17 effect). C17.2 and C17.3 are the preconditions of O3 (Spec 1 §62);
C17.4 is `CtrlRight`. The controller update is a realization obligation (WC4 C17), not a
precondition; only `ok` is defined. -/
def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C18.1–C18.3): the entry becomes available; the
kernel state is unchanged (WC4 C18 effect). WC4 C18.3: "`ControlOf(entry)` resolves to an
existing, usable controller **leaf**, as required by C21.3"; the controller-initialization
invariant is not a precondition (WC4 C18.3: "established separately for every live entry by
C21.7"). Only `ok` is defined. -/
def ResetLockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-! ## Derived arena operations executed by a context (Spec 1 §76–§78; WC4 C2, C19) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76; WC4 C2): the
clauses of `Arena.NewArenaBase` on the view of `c`, §76.6 being read on the concurrent kernel state
(WC4 C2, C3, C20: `WF3` and `I1` over the globally live frames, `AnchorOrder` and

(WC4 C2, C3, C20: `WF3` and `I1` over the globally live frames, `AnchorOrder` and
`AnchorOrderHeld` on `ancestorC`), and the guard of §76.4 over the arena registry and the
synchronization registry (Spec 1 §56: "all relevant registries of live administrations"; WC4
C13.7, OB-C16), with `Arena.Guard56`. -/
structure NewArenaPreC (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) (c storage internal : Nat) :
    Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : (s.view c).Usable storage
  /-- Spec 1 §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify storage
  /-- Spec 1 §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- Spec 1 §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- Spec 1 §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- Spec 1 §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- Spec 1 §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.flat.afp internal
  /-- Spec 1 §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => Arena.LeavesInit s.flat y.holder) True
  /-- Spec 1 §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state (WC4 C2, C20). -/
  wf3 : WF3 s.flat
  /-- Spec 1 §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state (WC4 C2). -/
  i1 : I1 s.flat
  /-- Spec 1 §76.6 re-indexed (WC4 C3): `AnchorOrder` (§44) on `ancestorC`. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC s
  /-- Spec 1 §76.6 re-indexed (WC4 C3): `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) on `ancestorC`. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC s
  /-- Spec 1 §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : Arena.ArenaInv s.flat ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩
  /-- Spec 1 §76.4, §56 (WC4 C13.7, OB-C16): no live administration of the arena registry nor of
  the synchronization registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Arena.Guard56 [Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar, liveGuardeds s reg] internal

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newArena` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76). -/
instance (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) (c storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPreC s reg ar c storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable storage ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    (s.view c).ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.flat.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => Arena.LeavesInit s.flat y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s.flat ∧ I1 s.flat ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧
    Arena.ArenaInv s.flat ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩ ∧
    Arena.Guard56 [Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar, liveGuardeds s reg] internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩⟩

/-- `newArena(storage, internal)` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76, §58: `ok` or `reject`): the entry of
`Arena.newArenaEff` is registered; the kernel state and the synchronization registry are
unchanged (§76 `ok` effect). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def NewArenaStepC (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) (c storage internal : Nat)
    (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (NewArenaPreC s reg ar c storage internal)
    (s, ar ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩]) o

/-- `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §77, §58; Part XIV: a
derived operation, on the pattern of `Arena.IssueD`): the static checks (§77.1, §77.2) and the
availability `fail` (§77.4) on the view of `c`; then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and
`store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8), both as executed by `c`
(`opStepC`; WC4 C2, C3: §65.4 and §65.5 read `ancestorC`); the metadata is updated on `ok`
(`Arena.issueMeta`). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
inductive IssueStepC (k : K) (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (region : List Nat)
    (dst : Nat) : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg) → Prop where
  | noEntry : s.Live c → ar[i]? = none → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | static {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      ¬ Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | fail {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → ¬ Arena.Avail E region →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .fail
  | split {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : ar[i]? = some E → Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst →
      Arena.Avail E region → opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s .reject →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | store {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ .reject → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | ok {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst (.ok (s₂, ar.set i (Arena.issueMeta s.flat E region)))

/-- `reset(arena)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §78, §58; Part XIV): the derived operation
`Arena.ResetD` (`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, `release`, the check of §78.3)
on the view of `c`, written back (WC4 C2); `derive` and `release` read neither `ancestor` nor the
stack beyond its top and its membership. A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def ResetStepC (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.view c, ar⟩ o₃ ∧
    o = omap (fun L' => (s.set L'.kern, L'.arenas)) o₃

/-- Writing back into `s` an `S3` whose stack is that of the view of `c`, then taking the view of
`c`, gives that `S3` back (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.view_set {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F) :
    (s.set t).view c = t := by
  have h : (s.set t).view c = { t with F := (s.view c).F } := rfl
  rw [h, ← hF]

/-- Writing back twice keeps the second state only (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.set_set (s : SC) (t u : S3) : (s.set t).set u = s.set u := rfl

/-- An `ok` outcome of `newArena` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §76): the preconditions hold and the
entry is registered. -/
theorem newArenaStepC_ok {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c st i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × ArenaReg} (h : NewArenaStepC s reg ar c st i (.ok st')) :
    s.Live c ∧ NewArenaPreC s reg ar c st i ∧
      st' = (s, ar ++ [⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩]) :=
  ⟨h.1, Guarded.ok_iff.1 h.2⟩

/-- An `ok` outcome of `issue` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §77, Part XIV): the static checks and
availability, then `split` then `store` executed by `c`, then the metadata update. -/
theorem issueStepC_ok {k : K} {s : SC} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {region : List Nat}
    {dst : Nat} {st' : SC × ArenaReg} (h : IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst (.ok st')) :
    ∃ E s₁, ar[i]? = some E ∧ Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst ∧
      Arena.Avail E region ∧ opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) ∧
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ (.ok st'.1) ∧
      st'.2 = ar.set i (Arena.issueMeta s.flat E region) := by
  cases h with
  | ok hE hst hav hsp hsto => exact ⟨_, _, hE, hst, hav, hsp, hsto, rfl⟩

/-- An `ok` outcome of `reset` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §78, Part XIV): `derive` of `internal` at
`Modify` over the storage then `release` of the derived authority, both executed by `c` (WC4 C2),
the check of §78.3 holding, then the metadata update. -/
theorem resetStepC_ok {k : K} {s : SC} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × ArenaReg}
    (h : ResetStepC s ar c i (.ok st')) :
    ∃ E s₁, ar[i]? = some E ∧
      opStepC k (.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify) c s (.ok s₁) ∧
      opStepC k (.release s.A.length) c s₁ (.ok st'.1) ∧ Arena.ResetNoDeps (s.view c) E ∧
      st'.2 = ar.set i (Arena.resetMeta s.flat E) := by
  obtain ⟨hl, o₃, hr, ho⟩ := h
  cases hr with
  | noEntry => cases ho
  | derive => cases ho
  | release => cases ho
  | contract => cases ho
  | @ok E t₁ t₂ hE hd hrl hnd =>
    cases ho
    have hF : t₁.F = (s.view c).F := by obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd; rfl
    refine ⟨E, s.set t₁, hE, ⟨hl, .ok t₁, hd, rfl⟩, ?_, hnd, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hl, .ok t₂, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [SC.view_set hF]; exact hrl

/-- Separation of the two registries of live administrations (Spec 1 §56: "An authority identity
may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction"; WC4 C13.7, OB-C16): no
identity is at once the `guarded` of a live synchronization entry and the `internal` of a live
arena. -/
def AdminSep (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, ∀ E ∈ ar, e.Live s → Arena.Live s.flat E → e.guarded ≠ E.internal

/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/

/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
inductive Label where
  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | terminate (c : Nat)
  | join (c d : Nat)
  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
  | newMutex (c g : Nat)
  | acquire (c i : Nat)
  | unlock (c i : Nat)
  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
  | spawnVal (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat))
  | newArena (c storage internal : Nat)
  | issue (c arena : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (c arena : Nat)

/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization and arena libraries
(WC4 C2, C4, C5, C6–C8, C13, C15–C18, C19; WC4 C23 for the by-value composite; Spec 1 §76–§78 for
the arenas): kernel and frame steps keep both registries; raw `deriveSync` runs under the library
instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC4 C14); the mutex operations change
the synchronization registry, the arena operations the arena registry (Spec 1 §46). -/
inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat}
      {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} :
      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c d : Nat} :
      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c g : Nat} :
      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') →
      LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c g : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      NewMutexOk k L ar s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, st'.2, ar)
  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, st'.2, ar)
  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, st'.2, ar)
  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, st'.2, ar)
  | spawnVal {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat}
      {ls : LocalShape} {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} :
      SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') →
      LStep k L (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) (s, reg, ar) (s', reg, ar)
  | newArena {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c st i : Nat} {st' : SC × ArenaReg} :
      NewArenaStepC s reg ar c st i (.ok st') →
      LStep k L (.newArena c st i) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, reg, st'.2)
  | issue {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
      {st' : SC × ArenaReg} :
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst (.ok st') →
      LStep k L (.issue c i region dst) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, reg, st'.2)
  | reset {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {ar : ArenaReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × ArenaReg} :
      ResetStepC s ar c i (.ok st') → LStep k L (.reset c i) (s, reg, ar) (st'.1, reg, st'.2)

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the source `src` of a transfer in state `st`: for each live entry, `src` is
neither the place `slot` holding `guarded`, nor a strict structural subplace of `slot`, nor the
controller leaf `ctl`. -/
def TransferExcl (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
    OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => ¬ partOf st.1.P src q) True ∧
      ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some src

/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
§41), and is not represented. -/
def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf st.1.P p q → p = q) True
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
  | _ => True

/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : LRun k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23: "Any lemma conditional on encapsulation must expose that
condition in its theorem statement or the reachable-trace assumptions"): a run every step of which
satisfies `Encap` in the state where it is taken, read on the kernel state and the
synchronization registry. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ → EncapsulatedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ →
      EncapsulatedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- An encapsulated trace is a run. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace.run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') : LRun k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons _ hs _ ih => exact .cons hs ih

/-! ## Theorem 1, last part: `SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` without live entry (WC4 C14, C24) -/

/-- Theorem 1 (WC4 C14, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, the obligation of WC4
C14 makes `K_C.SyncAuthorized` false on that registry. Fragment: every state, single-context ones
included. -/
theorem syncAuthorized_false {kc : KC SyncReg} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC}
    (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s) (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (g f : Nat) :
    ¬ kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f := fun h => by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -, hl⟩ := hsound g f h

import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable
import Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-!
# Mutex transfer, `endUse` and `Encap` (test module)

Concrete runs checking `Encap` (WC4 C22.3, C22.5) and the initialization invariant (WC4 C21.7)
against WC4 C12, S7, S16, S17 and S18:

* a mutex value `M = {slot, lock}` owning the protected root `T`; `guarded` is a `Modify`
  derivative of the root authority of `T`, stored in `slot` (Spec 1 §60, §65); `M′ = {slot′, lock′}`
  is a place of the same shape in the same frame; `Y` is a one-leaf place;
* variants A (`grant = none`) and B (an active grant): `transfer(M, M′)` is an `ok` step admitted
  by `Encap`, after which `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline` hold and `ControlOf` designates
  `lock′` (S16, positive half);
* `transfer(slot, Y)` and `transfer(lock, Y)`: `ok` kernel steps excluded by `Encap`, after which
  `SyncInv` fails (S16 and its extension);
* `endUse(lock)`, and `endUse` of a strict part of `slot` (S17a, S17b): `ok` kernel steps excluded
  by `Encap` (WC4 C22.5), after which `SyncInv` fails (`ctlInit`, `slotInit`); `endUse(M)` and
  `endUse(slot)`: `ok` steps admitted by `Encap` that end the entry, after which `SyncInv` holds;
* a run whose `endUse` steps break WC4 C21.7, followed by `transfer(M₁, M₂)`, gives two live
  entries the same controller (`endUse_then_transfer_merges`); it is not an `EncapsulatedTrace`
  (`endUse_then_transfer_merges_false`);
* `newMutex` on a mutex value whose fields are `Uninit` is rejected by WC4 C13.10
  (`newMutex_uninit_rejected`), so the run of `transfer_merges_controllers_false` is not a run.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## States -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M`, `1` its field `slot`, `2` its field `lock`
(`Init`), `3` the protected root `T` (`Init`), owned by `M`; `4` the place `M′` with fields `5`
(`slot′`) and `6` (`lock′`), `Uninit`; `7` the one-leaf place `Y`, `Uninit`. Root authorities: `0`
of `M`, `1` of `T` (held by `M`), `2` of `M′`, `3` of `Y`. -/
def est : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 0, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem est_ok : StaticsOK est := by decide

/-- `DDSound` for the test contract `K0` (Spec 1 §80): nothing is declared disjoint. -/
theorem ddK0 : DDSound K0 := fun _ _ h => h.elim

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47). -/
def e0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init est)

/-- `derive(1, footprint(T) = [3], Modify)` by context 0 (Spec 1 §60): authority 4, `guarded`. -/
def e1 : SC := e0.set (deriveEff (e0.view 0) 1 [3] .modify)

/-- `store(4, slot = 1)` by context 0 (Spec 1 §65): `guarded` is held by `slot`. -/
def e2 : SC := storeEffC e1 0 4 1

/-- Registry after `newMutex(4)` (WC4 C13). -/
def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨4, none⟩]

/-- Variant A: `transfer(M = 0, M′ = 4)` by context 0 with `grant = none` (Spec 1 §63). -/
def eA : SC := transferEffC e2 0 0 4

/-- Variant B, first step: `acquire` on entry 0 (WC4 C16): grant authority 5, held by frame 0. -/
def e3 : SC := deriveSyncEff e2 0 4

/-- Registry after `acquire` (WC4 C16). -/
def reg2 : SyncReg := [⟨4, some 5⟩]

/-- Variant B: `transfer(M = 0, M′ = 4)` by context 0 with the grant active (Spec 1 §63). -/
def eB : SC := transferEffC e3 0 0 4

/-- `transfer(slot = 1, Y = 7)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §63). -/
def eC : SC := transferEffC e2 0 1 7

/-! ## Steps -/

/-- The derivation of `guarded` is an `ok` step (Spec 1 §60). -/
theorem step_derive : opStepC K0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify) 0 e0 (.ok e1) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- The store of `guarded` in `slot` is an `ok` step (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed). -/
theorem step_store : opStepC K0 (.store 4 1) 0 e1 (.ok e2) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `newMutex(4)` is enabled (WC4 C13); its controller is `lock` (place 2). -/
theorem step_newMutex : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] e2 [] 0 4 (e2, reg1) ∧
    ControlOf L0 e2 ⟨4, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-- `acquire` is enabled (WC4 C16); the grant 5 is an active `Modify` derivative of `guarded` over
`footprint(T)`, held by frame 0, the current frame. -/
theorem step_acquire : AcquireOk K0 L0 e2 reg1 0 0 (e3, reg2) ∧
    e3.A[5]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ ∧ (e3.view 0).top = 0 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨4, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- Verdict (a), variant A: `transfer(M, M′)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed. -/
theorem stepA_transfer : opStepC K0 (.transfer 0 4) 0 e2 (.ok eA) :=
  ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Verdict (a), variant B: `transfer(M, M′)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed. -/
theorem stepB_transfer : opStepC K0 (.transfer 0 4) 0 e3 (.ok eB) :=
  ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `transfer(slot, Y)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed. -/
theorem stepC_transfer : opStepC K0 (.transfer 1 7) 0 e2 (.ok eC) :=
  ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ## The transfer clause of `Encap` -/

/-- The transfer clause of `Encap` is WC4 C22.3 (`TransferExcl`): the source is compared with
the place holding `guarded`, its structural subplaces, and the controller leaf, for every live
entry. -/
theorem encap_transfer_iff (st : SC × SyncReg) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Encap L0 st (.kernel c (.transfer src dst)) ↔ TransferExcl L0 st src :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- In `e2`, `guarded` (authority 4) is held by `slot` (place 1), a field of `M` (place 0). -/
theorem guarded_in_slot : (e2.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 1) ∧
    parentOf e2.P 1 = some 0 := by decide

/-- Verdict (b): `Encap` admits `transfer(M, M′)` in both variants and excludes
`transfer(slot, Y)` (WC4 C22.3 (a)) and `transfer(lock, Y)` (C22.3 (c)). -/
theorem encap_verdicts : Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    Encap L0 (e3, reg2) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 2 7)) :=
  ⟨(by decide : TransferExcl L0 (e2, reg1) 0), (by decide : TransferExcl L0 (e3, reg2) 0),
    (by decide : ¬ TransferExcl L0 (e2, reg1) 1), (by decide : ¬ TransferExcl L0 (e2, reg1) 2)⟩

/-! ## Traces and invariants -/

/-- Variant A as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state with an empty registry (WC4 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceA : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
     .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eA, reg1, []) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.1 (.kernel stepA_transfer) .nil

/-- Variant B as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state with an empty registry (WC4 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceB : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
     .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eB, reg2, []) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.acquire step_acquire.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.2.1 (.kernel stepB_transfer) .nil

/-- The trace up to `newMutex` (WC4 C13) as an `EncapsulatedTrace`. -/
theorem traceMutex : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4] (e2, reg1, []) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) .nil

/-- `KInvCA` and `SyncState` after `newMutex` (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem inv2 : KInvCA e2 ∧ SyncState L0 e2 reg1 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨(trace_inv ddK0 traceMutex hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 traceMutex hk hs).2.1⟩

/-- Verdict (c), variant A, positive twin of `transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected` (WC4 C22.3,
S16 and S18 positive halves): after `transfer(M, M′)` onto a destination with no entry, `KInvC`
(with the auxiliaries of Spec 1) and `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`) hold, and the
entry is live. -/
theorem invA : KInvCA eA ∧ SyncState L0 eA reg1 ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eA := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨(trace_inv ddK0 traceA hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 traceA hk hs).2.1, by decide⟩

/-- Verdict (c), variant B (from `trace_inv`): after `transfer(M, M′)`, `KInvC` (with the
auxiliaries of Spec 1) and `SyncState` hold; the entry is live and the grant 5 is still active
and held by frame 0. -/
theorem invB : KInvCA eB ∧ SyncState L0 eB reg2 ∧ (⟨4, some 5⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eB ∧
    eB.A[5]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨(trace_inv ddK0 traceB hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 traceB hk hs).2.1, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- Verdict (d), WC4 S16 positive half: after `transfer(M, M′)`, in both variants, `guarded` is
held by `slot′` (place 5) and `ControlOf` designates `lock′` (place 6) (WC4 C12, positional). -/
theorem controlAB : (eA.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) ∧
    ControlOf L0 eA ⟨4, none⟩ = some 6 ∧
    (eB.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) ∧ ControlOf L0 eB ⟨4, some 5⟩ = some 6 := by
  decide

/-- After `transfer(M, M′)` (Spec 1 §63 effect: places owned by a part `r` of the source become
owned by `corr(r)`, and their roots follow by `RootHeld`), `T` is owned by `M′` and its root
authority 1 is held by `M′`. -/
theorem ownerA : (eA.P[3]?).map (·.owner) = some (.place 4) ∧
    (eA.A[1]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) := by decide

/-! ## Transfers excluded by WC4 C22.3 (S16) -/

/-- WC4 S16, C22.3 (a): from `e2` (`KInvCA` and `SyncState` hold), `transfer(slot, Y)`
is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed; `Encap` excludes it; after it, the kernel invariant
`KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, `guarded` is held by `Y`, which has no structural parent,
`ControlOf` is undefined, and `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.3 with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12)
fails. -/
theorem slot_transfer_breaks_control :
    KInvCA e2 ∧ SyncState L0 e2 reg1 ∧ opStepC K0 (.transfer 1 7) 0 e2 (.ok eC) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) ∧ KInvCA eC ∧
    (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eC ∧ (eC.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 7) ∧
    parentOf eC.P 7 = none ∧ ControlOf L0 eC ⟨4, none⟩ = none ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eC reg1 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := inv2
  refine ⟨hk, hs, stepC_transfer, encap_verdicts.2.2.1,
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) (st := (e2, reg1, []))
      (st' := (eC, reg1, [])) (.kernel stepC_transfer) hk, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.control ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
  revert this; decide

/-- `transfer(lock = 2, Y = 7)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §63). -/
def eD : SC := transferEffC e2 0 2 7

/-- WC4 S16 extended, C22.3 (c): from `e2`, `transfer(lock, Y)` is an `ok` step of
Spec 1 §63 re-indexed; `Encap` excludes it; after it, `KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, its
controller is still `lock` (place 2), which is `Moved`, and `SyncInv` fails (`ctlInit`, WC4
C21.7). -/
theorem ctl_transfer_breaks_ctlInit :
    opStepC K0 (.transfer 2 7) 0 e2 (.ok eD) ∧ ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 2 7)) ∧
    KInvCA eD ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eD ∧ ControlOf L0 eD ⟨4, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    eD.I 2 = .moved ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eD reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.transfer 2 7) 0 e2 (.ok eD) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  refine ⟨hst, encap_verdicts.2.2.2,
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.transfer 2 7)) (st := (e2, reg1, []))
      (st' := (eD, reg1, [])) (.kernel hst) inv2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.ctlInit ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
  revert this; decide

/-! ## `endUse` on the controller or on a strict part of `slot` (Spec 1 §69; WC4 C22.5, S17) -/

/-- `endUse(lock = 2)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def eU : SC := e2.set (endUseEff (e2.view 0) 2)

/-- WC4 S17a, C22.5 (a): from `e2`, reached by the encapsulated trace `traceMutex`, `endUse(lock)`
is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69 re-indexed and `Encap` excludes it. Without the exclusion, after the
step `KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, its controller `lock` (place 2) is `Uninit` (Spec 1 §69
effect: "The leaves of value `place` become `Uninit`"), and `SyncInv` fails (`ctlInit`, WC4
C21.7). -/
theorem endUse_ctl_excluded :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4] (e2, reg1, []) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 e2 (.ok eU) ∧ ¬ Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) ∧
    KInvCA eU ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eU ∧ ControlOf L0 eU ⟨4, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    eU.I 2 = .uninit ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eU reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 e2 (.ok eU) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨traceMutex, hst,
    fun h => (h ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).1 (by decide),
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) (st := (e2, reg1, []))
      (st' := (eU, reg1, [])) (.kernel hst) inv2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.ctlInit ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
  revert this; decide

/-- `endUse(M = 0)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def eM : SC := e2.set (endUseEff (e2.view 0) 0)

/-- Positive twin of `endUse_ctl_excluded` (WC4 C22.5, S17b positive): from `e2`, `endUse(M)` is
an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69 re-indexed admitted by `Encap`; the entry is live before the step and
not after it (`guarded`, held by `slot`, a place of `M`, becomes inactive), and the encapsulated
trace ending with it reaches a state where `KInvCA` and `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`)
hold (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem endUse_mutex_kills_entry :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1, []) ∧
    (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live e2 ∧ ¬ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eM ∧
    KInvCA eM ∧ SyncState L0 eM reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 0) 0 e2 (.ok eM) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have he : Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)) :=
    (by decide : ∀ e ∈ reg1, e.Live e2 → ControlOf L0 e2 e ≠ some 0 ∧
      OptP (slotOf e2 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf e2.P 0 q → 0 = q) True)
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [], [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4,
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1, []) :=
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <| .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
    .cons he (.kernel hst) .nil
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨ht, by decide, by decide, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).2.1⟩

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`, a structure with the
leaves `2` and `3`) and `4` (`lock`), all leaves `Init`; `5` the root `T`, owned by `slot`. Root
authorities: `0` of `M`, `1` of `T` (held by `slot`, `guarded`). -/
def sst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), true),
   ((some 1, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem sst_ok : StaticsOK sst := by decide

/-- Initial single-context state of `sst`. -/
def z0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init sst)

/-- `newMutex(1)` is enabled in `z0` (WC4 C13). -/
theorem z_newMutex : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] z0 [] 0 1 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `endUse(2)`, a strict part of `slot`, by context 0 (Spec 1 §69). -/
def z1 : SC := z0.set (endUseEff (z0.view 0) 2)

/-- WC4 S17b, C22.5 (b): from the initial state of `sst`, after the encapsulated step
`newMutex(1)`, `endUse(2)` on a strict structural subplace of `slot` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69
re-indexed and `Encap` excludes it. Without the exclusion, after the step `KInvCA` holds, the
entry is live, leaf 2 of `slot` is `Uninit`, and `SyncInv` fails (`slotInit`, WC4 C21.7). -/
theorem endUse_slotPart_excluded :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, [], []) [.newMutex 0 1] (z0, [⟨1, none⟩], []) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 z0 (.ok z1) ∧ ¬ Encap L0 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) ∧
    KInvCA z1 ∧ (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z1 ∧ slotOf z1 1 = some 1 ∧ z1.I 2 = .uninit ∧
    ¬ SyncInv L0 z1 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 z0 (.ok z1) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have hk0 := (init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 sst_ok L0).1
  have hk : KInvCA z0 := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (z0, [], [])) (.newMutex z_newMutex) hk0
  refine ⟨.cons trivial (.newMutex z_newMutex) .nil, hst, fun h => ?_,
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.endUse 2))
      (st := (z0, [⟨1, none⟩], [])) (st' := (z1, [⟨1, none⟩], [])) (.kernel hst) hk,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).2
    revert this; decide
  · have := h.slotInit ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
    revert this; decide

/-- `endUse(slot = 1)` by context 0 after `newMutex(1)` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def z2 : SC := z0.set (endUseEff (z0.view 0) 1)

/-- Positive twin of `endUse_slotPart_excluded` (WC4 C22.5, S17b positive): from `z0` with the
entry of `newMutex(1)`, `endUse(slot)` of the structured `slot` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69
re-indexed admitted by `Encap`; the entry is live before the step and not after it (`guarded`,
held by `slot`, becomes inactive), and the encapsulated trace ending with it reaches a state where
`KInvCA` and `SyncState` hold (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem endUse_slot_kills_entry :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, [], []) [.newMutex 0 1, .kernel 0 (.endUse 1)]
      (z2, [⟨1, none⟩], []) ∧
    (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z0 ∧ ¬ (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z2 ∧
    KInvCA z2 ∧ SyncState L0 z2 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 1) 0 z0 (.ok z2) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have he : Encap L0 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 1)) :=
    (by decide : ∀ e ∈ ([⟨1, none⟩] : SyncReg), e.Live z0 → ControlOf L0 z0 e ≠ some 1 ∧
      OptP (slotOf z0 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf z0.P 1 q → 1 = q) True)
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, [], []) [.newMutex 0 1, .kernel 0 (.endUse 1)]
      (z2, [⟨1, none⟩], []) :=
    .cons trivial (.newMutex z_newMutex) <| .cons he (.kernel hst) .nil
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 sst_ok L0
  exact ⟨ht, by decide, by decide, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).1, (trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs).2.1⟩

/-! ## Controller uniqueness after `endUse` (WC4 C21.4, C21.7, C22.3, C22.5) -/

/-- Statics: two mutex values `M₁ = {slot₁ = {a₁, b₁}, lock₁}` (places 0–4) and
`M₂ = {slot₂ = {a₂, b₂}, lock₂}` (places 5–9), all leaves `Init`; `T₁` (10) owned by `slot₁` and
`T₂` (11) owned by `slot₂`. Root authorities: 0 (`M₁`), 1 (`M₂`), 2 (`T₁`, held by `slot₁`), 3
(`T₂`, held by `slot₂`). -/
def ust : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), true),
   ((some 1, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 5, none, 0), false), ((some 6, none, 0), true),
   ((some 6, none, 0), true), ((some 5, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 6, 0), true)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem ust_ok : StaticsOK ust := by decide

/-- Initial state of `ust`. -/
def u0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init ust)
/-- Registry after `newMutex(2)` and `newMutex(3)`. -/
def regU : SyncReg := [⟨2, none⟩, ⟨3, none⟩]
/-- `endUse(a₂ = 7)`. -/
def u1 : SC := u0.set (endUseEff (u0.view 0) 7)
/-- `endUse(b₂ = 8)`. -/
def u2 : SC := u1.set (endUseEff (u1.view 0) 8)
/-- `endUse(lock₂ = 9)`. -/
def u3 : SC := u2.set (endUseEff (u2.view 0) 9)
/-- `transfer(M₁ = 0, M₂ = 5)`. -/
def u4 : SC := transferEffC u3 0 0 5

/-- WC4 C21.4 fails along a run whose `endUse` steps break WC4 C21.7: from the initial state of
`ust`, the run `newMutex(2)`, `newMutex(3)`, `endUse` of the two leaves of `slot₂` and of `lock₂`,
then `transfer(M₁, M₂)` reaches a state where `KInvCA` holds, both entries are live, both have the
controller `lock₂` (place 9), and `SyncInv` fails. Its first `endUse` step is excluded by `Encap`
(WC4 C22.5 (b)), so the run is not an `EncapsulatedTrace` (`endUse_then_transfer_merges_false`). -/
theorem endUse_then_transfer_merges :
    LRun K0 L0 (u0, [], [])
      [.newMutex 0 2, .newMutex 0 3, .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] (u4, regU, []) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (u0, regU) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 7)) ∧ KInvCA u4 ∧
    (⟨2, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live u4 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live u4 ∧
    ControlOf L0 u4 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 9 ∧ ControlOf L0 u4 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 9 ∧
    ¬ SyncInv L0 u4 regU := by
  have h1 : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] u0 [] 0 2 (u0, [⟨2, none⟩]) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have h2 : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] u0 [⟨2, none⟩] 0 3 (u0, regU) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have h3 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 7) 0 u0 (.ok u1) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h4 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 8) 0 u1 (.ok u2) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h5 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 9) 0 u2 (.ok u3) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h6 : opStepC K0 (.transfer 0 5) 0 u3 (.ok u4) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  have hr : LRun K0 L0 (u0, [], [])
      [.newMutex 0 2, .newMutex 0 3, .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] (u4, regU, []) :=
    .cons (.newMutex h1) <| .cons (.newMutex h2) <| .cons (.kernel h3) <| .cons (.kernel h4) <|
    .cons (.kernel h5) <| .cons (.kernel h6) .nil
  have hk0 := (init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 ust_ok L0).1
  have hk : KInvCA u4 := by
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, [], [])) (.newMutex h1) hk0
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, [⟨2, none⟩], [])) (.newMutex h2) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, regU, [])) (.kernel h3) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u1, regU, [])) (.kernel h4) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u2, regU, [])) (.kernel h5) this
    exact lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u3, regU, [])) (.kernel h6) this
  refine ⟨hr, fun h => ?_, hk, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide)).2
    revert this; decide
  · have := h.ctlUnique 0 1 ⟨2, none⟩ ⟨3, none⟩ 9 rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)
    cases this

/-- The run of `endUse_then_transfer_merges` is not an `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.5 (b)): after
the two `newMutex` steps, whose results are determined, `Encap` excludes `endUse(a₂)`. -/
theorem endUse_then_transfer_merges_false (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) :
    ¬ EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (u0, [], [])
      [.newMutex 0 2, .newMutex 0 3, .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] st := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | cons _ h1 h2 =>
    cases h1 with
    | newMutex hn1 =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn1
      cases h2 with
      | cons _ h3 h4 =>
        cases h3 with
        | newMutex hn2 =>
          obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn2
          cases h4 with
          | cons he _ _ => exact endUse_then_transfer_merges.2.1 he

/-! ## `newMutex` on `Uninit` fields is rejected (WC4 C13.10) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`) and `2` (`lock`), both
`Init`; `3` the root `T`, owned by `slot`; `4` the mutex value `M′` with fields `5` (`slot′`) and
`6` (`lock′`), both `Uninit`; `7` the root `T′`, owned by `slot′`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, some 5, 0), true)]

/-- Initial single-context state of `mst`. -/
def m0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- WC4 C13.10 (`initM`): in `m0`, `newMutex(1)` is accepted and `newMutex(3)` is rejected, the
fields of `M′` being `Uninit`. -/
theorem newMutex_uninit_rejected : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] m0 [] 0 1 (m0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    ¬ NewMutexPre K0 L0 [] m0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 3 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-- The labels `newMutex(1)`, `newMutex(3)`, `transfer(M, M′)` from `m0` form no run: the second
step, `newMutex(3)`, has no `ok` outcome (`newMutex_uninit_rejected`). -/
theorem transfer_merges_controllers_false (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) :
    ¬ LRun K0 L0 (m0, [], []) [.newMutex 0 1, .newMutex 0 3, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] st := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | cons h1 h2 =>
    cases h1 with
    | newMutex hn1 =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn1
      cases h2 with
      | cons h3 _ =>
        cases h3 with
        | newMutex hn2 => exact newMutex_uninit_rejected.2 hn2.2.1

end Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Minimal traces (test module)

Concrete states and runs used by the theorems of the concurrent milestone (constructions and
counterexamples), checked by `decide`. The corpus of WC4 §V (S1a–S18) is covered only for S4, S9
(positive halves) and S16 (`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces`).

* a mutex value `m = {data, lock}` whose field `data` owns the protected storage `T` (WC4 C13),
  its registration by `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`;
* theorem 4, counterexample without encapsulation (WC4 C22.1): `derive(guarded, Observe, footprint(T))` by the
  exclusive owner makes `acquire` not enabled while `grant = none` (`acquire_blocked_by_derive`);
  the encapsulated twin enables it (`acquire_enabled`);
* theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant: a state with `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the library
  instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`, violating `I1`, where `deriveSync` is not enabled
  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
  (`frames_run`); `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`), on an unknown identifier
  it is rejected (`join_unknown_rejected`);
* a second `newMutex` on a protected root owned by the same field, hence with the same controller,
  is rejected (`shared_controller_rejected`, WC4 C13.8); two mutex values with distinct
  controllers are both accepted (`distinct_controllers_ok`, WC4 S9);
* S4: a child receives a value through the by-value composite and survives the exit of the
  creating frame (`s4_detached_child`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Traces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Mutex value (WC4 C12, C13) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The reference layout (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the first field, the controller is the
second. -/
def L0 : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47): root authority `0` of `m` held by frame 0, root
authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/
def c0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide

/-- After `newMutex(guarded = 1)` (WC4 C13). -/
def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩]

/-- `newMutex(1)` executed by context 0 is enabled on `c0`; its controller is place 2. -/
theorem newMutex_ok : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] c0 [] 0 1 (c0, reg1) ∧
    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩
invariant (WC4 C20): `KInvC` is not vacuous on multi-context states. -/
theorem f2_kInvC : KInvC f2 := by
  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := f2.flat) (by decide)).1
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, hno⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨⟨framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), hw⟩,
    ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩

/-! ## Controller uniqueness at construction (WC4 C13.8, S9) -/

/-- Statics: the mutex value `m = {data, lock}` and two protected roots `T₁`, `T₂` both owned by
`data`. -/
def mst2 : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state: root authorities 1 (of `T₁`) and 2 (of `T₂`) are both held by `data`. -/
def d0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst2)

/-- WC4 C13.8: after `newMutex(1)`, the entry of `guarded = 2` would have the same positional
controller (place 2) as the live entry of `guarded = 1`; the second `newMutex` is rejected. -/
theorem shared_controller_rejected : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] d0 [] 0 1 (d0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 d0 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    ¬ NewMutexPre K0 L0 [] d0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- Statics: two mutex values `m₁ = {data₁, lock₁}` (places 0–2) and `m₂ = {data₂, lock₂}`
(places 3–5), owning the protected roots `T₁` (place 6, owned by `data₁`) and `T₂` (place 7, owned
by `data₂`). Root authorities: 0 (`m₁`), 1 (`m₂`), 2 (`T₁`, held by `data₁`), 3 (`T₂`, held by
`data₂`). -/
def mst3 : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, none, 0), true), ((some 3, none, 0), true), ((some 3, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 4, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of `mst3`. -/
def d1 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst3)

/-- Positive twin of `shared_controller_rejected` (WC4 S9, C13.8): `newMutex(2)` then
`newMutex(3)` are accepted, with the distinct controllers `lock₁` (place 2) and `lock₂` (place
5). -/
theorem distinct_controllers_ok : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] d1 [] 0 2 (d1, [⟨2, none⟩]) ∧
    NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] d1 [⟨2, none⟩] 0 3 (d1, [⟨2, none⟩, ⟨3, none⟩]) ∧
    ControlOf L0 d1 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ ControlOf L0 d1 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 5 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- The two constructions of `distinct_controllers_ok` as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from `d1` with an
empty registry (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem distinct_controllers_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (d1, [], [])
    [.newMutex 0 2, .newMutex 0 3] (d1, [⟨2, none⟩, ⟨3, none⟩], []) :=
  .cons trivial (.newMutex distinct_controllers_ok.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex distinct_controllers_ok.2.1) .nil

/-! ## S4: a detached child survives its creator (WC4 S4, C5, C6) -/

/-- Statics: one `Init` static place (place 0), owned by frame 0. -/
def s4st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial single-context state of `s4st` (Spec 1 §47). -/
def q0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init s4st)
/-- Context 0 enters frame 1 with two locals, `v` (place 1) and `p` (place 2) (Spec 1 §72). -/
def q1 : SC := enterEffC q0 0 [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]
/-- `write` of `v` through its root authority 1 (Spec 1 §67). -/
def q2 : SC := q1.set (write3Eff (q1.view 0) [1])
/-- `write` of `p` through its root authority 2 (Spec 1 §67). -/
def q3 : SC := q2.set (write3Eff (q2.view 0) [2])
/-- `alloc(provider p, owner v, one leaf)` (Spec 1 §71): the root `T` (place 3) owned by `v`, its
root authority 3 held by `v`. -/
def q4 : SC := q3.set (allocEff (q3.view 0) 1 [(none, 0)])
/-- From frame 1, the by-value composite (WC4 C5) creates context 1 (frame 2) with one local `d`
(place 4) and moves `v` into `d`. -/
def q5 : SC := spawnValEff q4 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)]
/-- Frame 1 exits (WC4 C6); context 1 is reparented to frame 0. -/
def q6 : SC := exitEffC q5 0

/-- The steps of S4 are `ok` (Spec 1 §72, §67, §71; WC4 C5, C6). -/
theorem s4_steps : opStepC K0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]) 0 q0 (.ok q1) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.write 1 [1]) 0 q1 (.ok q2) ∧ opStepC K0 (.write 2 [2]) 0 q2 (.ok q3) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)]) 0 q3 (.ok q4) ∧
    SpawnValStep K0 q4 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)] (.ok q5) ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 q5 (.ok q6) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide) trivial, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- The steps of S4 as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from `q0` with an empty registry (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem s4_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (q0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]), .kernel 0 (.write 1 [1]),
     .kernel 0 (.write 2 [2]), .kernel 0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)]),
     .spawnVal 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)], .kernel 0 .exit] (q6, [], []) :=
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.1) <| .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.1) <| .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨fun _ h => (by cases h), trivial⟩ (.spawnVal s4_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.2.2) .nil

/-- WC4 S4, positive: after the exit of the creating frame 1, the child context 1 is live, its
initial frame is reparented to frame 0, `d` (place 4) and the storage `T` it now owns (place 3)
are usable, the root authority of `T` is held by `d`, and the re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`
(hence `ConcurrentWF`) holds. -/
theorem s4_detached_child : q6.Live 1 ∧ q6.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧ q6.flat.Usable 4 ∧
    q6.flat.Usable 3 ∧ (q6.A[3]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) ∧ KInvC q6 ∧
    ConcurrentWF q6 := by
  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := q6.flat) (by decide)).1
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, hno⟩ := hk
  have hfr : FramesC q6 :=
    framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hkc : KInvC q6 :=
    ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩
  exact ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, hkc, hkc.1⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Traces

hsep e hm E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl
        (by show s.flat.Active E.internal; rw [heq]; exact hl) heq.symm
    have hw₁ : WF3 s₁.flat := wf3_after_view hk.1.1.1
      (show ViewStep ((KernelOp.derive E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify).Step k) c s
        (.ok s₁) from hd)
      fun t' hR => by
        have hR' : DeriveStep E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify (s.view c) (.ok t') := hR
        refine ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 (SC.wf3_view hk.1.1.1 hw) hR', ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'; rfl
    exact kernel_syncState hrl trivial (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ e => by cases e) hw₁ hw'
      (kernel_syncState hd hsep' (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ e => by cases e) hw hw₁ hs)

/-! ## A transfer onto a live mutex value is rejected (WC4 S18, C21.7; Spec 1 §63.3) -/

/-- WC4 S18 (C21.7 with Spec 1 §63.3): under `SyncState`, a `transfer` whose destination contains
the mutex value of a live entry is rejected, its controller leaf being `Init`. Positive twins:
`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invA`, `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invB`. -/
theorem transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c src dst m : Nat} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg)
    (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) (hm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m)
    (hmd : partOf s.P m dst) : ¬ TransferPreC k s c src dst := by
  intro hpre
  have h3 := hs.1.control e he hl
  have h4 := hs.1.ctlInit e he hl
  cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
  | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3
  | some ctl =>
    rw [hco] at h3 h4; simp only [OptP] at h3 h4
    obtain ⟨y, q, m', hy, hh, hm', -, hkc⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.controlOf_spec hco

## 43. Effective Rights and Exercise of Authorities

For an authority `a` and a leaf `l`, `effective(s,a,l)` is derived from the active descendants of `a` whose footprint contains `l`:

1. if `a` is inactive or does not cover `l`, its effective mode is absent;
2. if no active descendant covers `l`, the effective mode is the own mode of `a`;
3. if an active descendant with own mode `Modify` covers `l`, the effective mode of `a` is absent;
4. otherwise, when the covering active descendants are `Observe`, the effective mode of `a` on `l` is `Observe`.

The effect is **local to each leaf**: after splitting a region, the origin may retain effective `Modify` over undistributed leaves.

Requested modes are ordered `Observe ≤ Modify`. `ExercisableAt(s,a,m)` means:

- `a` is active and its own mode permits `m`;
- either `a` is held by the current frame;
- or `a` is held by a place `p`, and the current frame has, over **all** leaves of `p`, an authority itself exercisable in mode `m` with sufficient effective mode.

The latter clause is recursive along the holder chain. Thus, being active or covering a leaf does not automatically make an authority exercisable. `HasRight(s,m,p)` means the current frame has exercise in mode `m` and sufficient effective mode **over every leaf in `p`'s footprint**. Every operation requires the modes it actually needs; an authority's own mode alone is insufficient.

## 44. Dependencies and Effective Anchors

`D(p)` is the set of authorities serving as **validity anchors** for place `p`. An anchor is valid as long as the authority it names is active. Dependencies of contained values are accounted for transitively. Relevant dependencies follow the value during transfer; those of its container do not automatically follow a part transferred in isolation.

For an authority `x`, its **effective anchor** is the root reached by traversing its origin chain. It does not necessarily coincide with its current holder. Lifetime constraints are calculated from the frame of that effective anchor and the frames of places that remain usable. A dependency cannot create a right or artificially extend a lifetime.

`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, that the frame of the effective anchor of `x` be the frame of `q` or one of its ancestors. `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every **active authority held** by `q`. These conditions apply to the resulting states of operations that move or create holder relations.

## 45. Parameters, Returns, and Reanchoring

A call parameter is an **active derived authority held by the caller** before being passed to the callee; its original provenance may go back to an earlier frame. This interpretation does not require that the authority was originally derived in the calling frame; that additional requirement belongs to Spec 3. The caller **yields** the authority to the new frame: it does not simultaneously retain a copy. If the authority remains in that frame upon return, `exitFrame` releases it; **it is not automatically returned to the caller**. To retain its own right, the caller may pass a **fresh derivative** of the authority it wishes to keep: this is ordinary reborrowing. The definition of ergonomic calling conventions is deferred to Spec 3.

A result is returned by a legal `transfer` into the result place provided by the caller as a `Modify` parameter. Surviving authorities and their dependencies are reanchored by `exitFrame` to still-valid origins. There is no standalone correspondence `M` and no implicit escape permission.

## 46. Arenas as Library Administration States
## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved. No active derived authority held outside `source` covers a source leaf, except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain. Other active authorities remain subject to this check. Authorities held by parts of `source` are transferred with the value and are controlled by §63.8.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.
9. **Destination usability:** `destination` is usable in the resulting state.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
§67.3, §68.3). -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
